help:
Show the machine time one sandbox has consumed, and what it costs

Usage: boat usage [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>  Sandbox ID, or "current"/"self".

Options:
      --api-url <API_URL>  [env: BOAT_API_URL=]
      --since <TIME>       Count from this time, ISO 8601 or Unix seconds. Default: when the sandbox was created.
      --org <ID_OR_NAME>   Run this command in an organization's billing scope. See `boat org list`. [env: BOAT_ORG=]
      --until <TIME>       Count up to this time, ISO 8601 or Unix seconds. Default: now.
      --json               Force machine-readable JSON/JSONL output
      --no-update          Skip the automatic CLI update (also BOAT_NO_UPDATE=1) [env: BOAT_NO_UPDATE=1]
  -h, --help               Print help
